title: Microsoft Foundry model evaluation service
description: Service-level configuration for a host: azure.ai.evaluation entry.

script.description: Python entry point, relative to the service project directory.

dataset.description: JSONL evaluation dataset, relative to the service project directory.

results.description: Directory where local copies of evaluation results are written.

datasetName.description: Name used when registering the dataset in Foundry.

datasetVersion.description: Version used when registering the dataset in Foundry. 'auto' creates a timestamped version for each deployment.

python.description: Optional Python executable. The service prefers .venv when omitted.

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time to wait for a managed evaluation run.

noWait.description: Submit the managed evaluation and return without polling.

tracing.description: Enable OpenTelemetry for remote submission and require a connected Application Insights resource.

captureContent.description: Include model messages in traces. Leave disabled unless privacy requirements permit content capture.
